name: Release v2.0.0-rc.2
body:
+ Features
  + Error handling
  + Switch to project on creation
+ Bug fixes:
  + Import project path dialog not working

name: Release v2.0.0-rc.1
body:
+ Features 
  + Pre-release channel
  + Better VSCode debugging

name: 1.6.0-beta - Reminders and today view
body:
+ Features
  + Cycle through navigation items with a shortcut
  + Today view
  + Reminders
  + Repeat presets
+ Bug fixes
  + Project created twice
  + Broken notifications

name: 1.5.0-beta - Theming and polising
body:
+ Features
  + Multiple themes
  + Arc Dark theme
  + Switched to scss
  + Better sidenav
  + Config and project files are now formatted
  + Config is now reloaded when reload button is clicked
+ Bug fixes
  + Invalid date errors
  + Weird toolbar
  + Project is no longer selected if only config button was clicked

name: 1.4.0-beta - Task repetition, task delete button and others
body:
+ Features
  + Added MacOS Icon
  + General Electron code cleanup
  + Added logging to Electron code
  + Window now toggles on tray click
  + Settings dialog now automatically resizes
  + Added task delete button
  + Added no project selected warning when creating a new task
  + Added task repetition
+ Bug fixed:
  + Input in the import project menu

name: 1.2.0-beta - Bintray, open-source
body:
+ Features
  + Bintray
  + Open source license
+ Bug fixes
  + Missing icon in menus on Debian
  + Missing icon in dock on Linux

name: 1.1.0-alpha - Icon, deadlines, keyboard shortcuts, autohiding menu, project import, better sys-tray
body:
+ Features
  + New icon
  + GitHub actions
  + Added Today message
  + Main menu autohides now
  + Calendar tab removed
  + Added `defaultProjectPath` setting
  + Redirecting when a project is deleted
  + Project import
  + Switched to `electron-builder`
  + Form submitting on `ctrl+enter`
  + Better handling of hiding the app to system-tray
  + Added deadline feature
  + Better handling of paths and related matter
  + Better logging
  + Keyboard shortcuts
  + Changed icons
+ Bug fixes:
  + Pressing cancel no longer leaves task empty
  + defaultProjectPath no longer set as an array
  + Pressing cancel in dialogs handled correctly
